name: vaultwarden.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Vaultwarden (passwords)
shortDescription: Your own password manager for the whole family, kept on your AVADO
description: Your own password manager, kept on your AVADO instead of in someone else's cloud. It works with the free Bitwarden apps and browser extension. Getting started: open Vaultwarden and choose "Create account". This first account is yours. Pick a strong master password and write it down: nobody, not even AVADO, can recover it. After this first account, nobody can sign up on their own. To add family members: in Vaultwarden choose "New organization" (for example "Family"), then "Invite member" and enter their e-mail address. They open Vaultwarden and choose "Create account" with that address. Then you open the menu next to their name and choose "Confirm". No e-mail is sent, so tell them yourself. In the Bitwarden app choose "Self-hosted" and enter https://vaultwarden.my.ava.do.
author: AVADO
